administrator-guide.functional_owner: BPM administrator and DevOps documentation maintainer

allowed_reuse: Describe verified BPM UI and API-adjacent product behavior in original prose.
Reuse stable product labels, identifiers, warnings, and tested workflow facts.
Generate examples only from deterministic BPM fixtures.
required_attribution: BPM MPL-2.0 license in the artifact legal page.
forbidden_reuse: Unverified implementation inference presented as user-visible behavior.
Secrets, personal data, local machine paths, or production profile content.
source_families.update_trigger: Any user-visible BPM behavior, route, label, or validation contract change.

authoritative_sources: BPM UI rendered from deterministic synthetic fixtures in each supported locale
allowed_reuse: Capture BPM-owned UI only with synthetic non-sensitive data.
Publish one reviewed visual variant per locale unless the locale-neutral exception is recorded.
required_attribution: BPM artifact license; locale and capture metadata in the screenshot manifest.
forbidden_reuse: Real user, organization, host, token, profile, or filesystem data.
Mozilla, CIS, or third-party logos added as decoration.
Screenshots of external sites or vendor products without a separate rights review.
source_families.update_trigger: Visible BPM UI, theme, locale copy, fixture, or viewport contract change.

allowed_reuse: Generate operation, parameter, model, status, and limitation facts.
Publish BPM-authored curl and Python examples tested against synthetic fixtures.
required_attribution: BPM source revision and OpenAPI document SHA-256.
forbidden_reuse: Invented authentication, rate-limit, idempotency, stability, or compatibility guarantees.
Credentials, real hosts, or third-party proprietary API examples.
source_families.update_trigger: OpenAPI document, route behavior, model, error, or limitation change.

allowed_reuse: Generate policy IDs, exact key names, types, required fields, enum values, defaults, compatibility metadata, and channel differences.
Publish independently authored BPM guidance and schema-valid synthetic examples.
required_attribution: Mozilla policy-templates repository and exact release tag.
MPL-2.0 notice and retained source/version/hash metadata.
Statement that BPM is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mozilla.
forbidden_reuse: Dropping x-bpm-source, source tag, schema fingerprint, or license notice.
Presenting a schema-derived fact as live-browser verification.
Using Mozilla logos or visual identity as BPM branding.
source_families.update_trigger: Mozilla policy-templates tag or BPM Release/ESR schema change.

allowed_reuse: Use official documentation to verify independently written BPM explanations.
Incorporate verbatim or adapted prose only in an explicitly source-tagged MPL-covered topic region with retained notice and source link.
required_attribution: Mozilla Contributors or repository attribution as stated by the source.
Exact page/repository URL, revision or release tag, retrieval date, and MPL-2.0 notice.
forbidden_reuse: Unmarked copy/paste of policy descriptions, tables, or examples.
Bulk mirroring of the Mozilla documentation site into BPM topics.
Assuming a moving web page matches the bundled v7.12 schemas.
source_families.update_trigger: Upstream page migration, policy semantics change, or schema refresh.

allowed_reuse: Link to an official page and use it as review evidence after recording URL and retrieval date.
required_attribution: Visible external source link and page title.
forbidden_reuse: Copy or adapt page prose, images, examples, or layout until that page's license is captured in a new matrix entry.
source_families.update_trigger: Need to reproduce rather than merely link to official web content.

allowed_reuse: Link to MDN and use it as technical review evidence.
Use a CC0 code sample only after a separate page-level provenance record proves that classification.
required_attribution: MDN page link when cited as review evidence.
forbidden_reuse: Copy or adapt MDN documentation prose into 0.9.0 topics by default.
Treat MDN prose as MPL-2.0 or omit ShareAlike attribution.
source_families.update_trigger: Any proposal to incorporate MDN prose or code rather than link to it.

allowed_reuse: Use the Firefox wordmark in truthful descriptive text about compatibility and managed policies.
required_attribution: Firefox is a trademark of the Mozilla Foundation in the U.S. and other countries.
Clear statement that BPM is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed, or approved by Mozilla.
forbidden_reuse: Mozilla or Firefox logos, icons, visual identity, or trade dress as BPM branding.
Any wording that implies Mozilla certification, sponsorship, affiliation, or endorsement.
source_families.update_trigger: Branding, logo, publication title, compatibility claim, or Mozilla policy change.

allowed_reuse: Use the official PDF locally to review BPM mapping accuracy.
Publish benchmark-derived expression only when a recorded distribution-rights approval states scope, license, attribution, ShareAlike, and commercial-use treatment.
required_attribution: Exact CIS benchmark name, version, official URL, and applicable license/terms.
Recorded rights_approval_id for any published benchmark-derived expression.
Independent-publication and no-endorsement disclaimer required by the applicable CIS policy.
forbidden_reuse: Commit, package, index, or publish the official PDF.
Copy recommendation titles, rationale, impact, audit, remediation, defaults, tables, screenshots, or substantial prose without recorded approval.
Use third-party mirrors as authoritative sources.
Claim CIS certification, endorsement, authorization, or complete compliance.
source_families.update_owner: BPM CIS data maintainer and BPM distribution-rights approver
source_families.update_trigger: New benchmark/version, changed CIS terms, or any proposed publication of benchmark-derived expression.

allowed_reuse: Use the applicable CIS wordmark accurately and only to identify the referenced benchmark or mapping context.
required_attribution: CIS trademark ownership notice in the legal/credits page.
Statement that the guide is an independent publication and has not been authorized, sponsored, or otherwise approved by CIS.
forbidden_reuse: CIS logos, icons, certified badges, certification marks, or trade dress without express written authorization.
Any claim or presentation implying CIS certification, membership, sponsorship, affiliation, endorsement, authorization, or approval.
source_families.update_owner: BPM product maintainer and BPM distribution-rights approver
source_families.update_trigger: CIS naming, branding, badge, certification, marketing, attribution, or trademark-policy change.

allowed_reuse: Describe BPM-authored mapping targets, configured values, merge outcomes, manual-review states, limitations, and UI workflows in original prose.
Use recommendation ID, benchmark identity/version, level, and source link solely to identify the mapping context.
required_attribution: CIS benchmark identity/version and official source link.
Notice that benchmark source material is separate from BPM's MPL-2.0 implementation.
Independent implementation, no certification, no endorsement, and verify-against-official-source disclaimer.
forbidden_reuse: Import source title/rationale/audit/remediation/default prose from curated benchmark records into published topics.
Describe BPM mappings as the complete benchmark or a substitute for licensed CIS material.
Turn an unresolved/non-publishable provenance record into guidance.
source_families.update_trigger: Mapping, layer, preset, merge rule, manual-review state, benchmark identity, or source terms change.

authoritative_sources: Vendor-owned official product documentation selected per integration scenario
allowed_reuse: Link to the official vendor page and describe a generic BPM API integration pattern without claiming a shipped connector.
required_attribution: Vendor name and official external source link when needed for context.
forbidden_reuse: Vendor prose, examples, screenshots, logos, schemas, or trademarks beyond truthful nominative reference.
Claims of partnership, certification, endorsement, support, or an implemented connector.
source_families.update_trigger: Any named third-party scenario or proposal to copy vendor-owned material.

authoritative_sources: Versioned BPM documentation fixtures and focused example tests
allowed_reuse: Publish deterministic, schema-valid, fictional JSON, curl, Python, profile, policy, and error examples.
required_attribution: BPM source revision and fixture/test ID.
forbidden_reuse: Real credentials, tokens, hosts, domains, users, organization names, profile names, or exported customer data.
Unvalidated examples copied from an external source.
source_families.update_trigger: Schema, API, validation, fixture, or example behavior change.

authoritative_sources: Approved English DITA topic and its complete provenance record
allowed_reuse: Create a human-reviewed locale peer only after the English source and its reuse mode are approved.
required_attribution: All source-family, license, notice, and rights-approval metadata inherited unchanged.
localized_from_topic_id and human reviewer identity.
forbidden_reuse: Unreviewed AI or machine-generated translation in the 0.9.0 documentation scope.
Removing attribution, changing license classification, translating stable IDs, or localizing blocked English content.
source_families.update_trigger: English source/provenance change or locale content update.

authoritative_sources: Reviewed DITA topics, approved assets, source records, and generated manifest
allowed_reuse: Generate HTML, search entries, manifests, examples, and packages only from publishable inputs.
required_attribution: Aggregate legal/notices page plus topic/source metadata required by every input.
forbidden_reuse: Treat generation, translation, indexing, hashing, or format conversion as removing source restrictions.
Index or package an approval-required source that lacks rights_approval_id.
source_families.update_trigger: Any input provenance, build transformation, packaging, or notice change.
